messages:
maya: quick FYI — canary with the new kernel selector pushed reserved GPU up ~1.9x on a mixed-length chat workload. Not a hard OOM but eviction noise and cost tail spiked.

oliver: seen. which model/quant and when did this hit canary?

maya: gptx-13b-q4_k on p4d, rolled 2026-03-10T15:12Z. traffic is bursty chat, median seq ~64 but long tail. kernel-path: dynamic switch to fused-attn -> fallback path engages on >128 seqs.

samir: can you paste allocator snapshot from the host that showed the spike?

maya: pasted below (trimmed) from gpu-27 during the window:
ALLOC_SNAPSHOT
 total_gpu: 40.0GB
 reserved_reported: 29.6GB
 in_use_alloc: 21.1GB
 workspace_peak: 18.9GB
 kv_cache_reserved: 6.4GB
 avg_padding_per_seq: 340B
 batch_slots: 312
 median_seq_len: 64
 effective_slots: 268

pj: avg_padding_per_seq 340B seems high for that median. is the kernel switch creating per-seq temporaries?

samir: yep — the new handoff path does a cudaMalloc per-mini-batch temp buffer for intermediate fused kernels. We forgot to reuse those via the workspace arena so they show up as extra reserved headroom until freed.

oliver: is it per-mini-batch or per-sequence? scale differs a lot.

maya: it's per-mini-batch but allocated across all sequences in a batch: observed temp_alloc ~= 1.1KB * effective_slots. so when batch grows it scales roughly linearly.

samir: repro command to simulate skewed seq dist here:
./tools/perf_sim --kernel=selector_handoff --model=gptx-13b-q4 --seq-dist=zipf --max-batch=512 --burst=60

oliver: ran the repro. heaplet trace shows allocate/free churn that increases reserved for ~150-250ms windows. quick fix is to allocate subviews from the workspace arena instead of separate cudaMallocs.

jin: also can temp reduce dynamic_pad_threshold. current headroom factor is 1.3x; try 1.05-1.1x for transient bursts and measure latency tail.

maya: applied a short-term canary mitigation: gate the new handoff on canary flag + enabled workspace-aggro-reuse. immediate effect: reserved down ~24%, eviction noise reduced.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-10T15:28:43Z -> canary (eng-runtime/canary): succeeded :rocket:

samir: long-term plan:
 - refactor kernel handoff to request workspace subviews (no independent cudaMallocs)
 - instrument per-request temp_alloc_bytes and per-seq pad breakdown telemetry
 - CI perf test simulating long-tail seq distributions

oliver: I'll add a perf gate that asserts reserved delta < 1.2x on kernel changes and checks both reserved and p99 latency. will add synthetic with zipf and bimodal seq dist.

samir: I'll own the workspace-subview refactor. will open PR with unit/alloc tests + perf hooks. tagging @jin for review on pad threshold tuning.

jin: happy to review. also suggest adding a reclamation watermark so reclaimed temp memory is visible in tracing and not blamed on slab fragmentation.

maya: note for repro: include KV cache warmup; kv_cache_reserved increases baseline and amplifies pressure when temp buffers are allocated.

infra-bot: alert: oom on gpu-9 2026-03-10T16:02:11Z (job: chat-ingest-phi) — canary only, no customer impact.

maya: thanks — keeping this thread as the coordination point. please ping infra-bot if any new canary OOMs show up.
